speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
text: asked the Minister for Education what is the education programme on child abuse and domestic violence awareness and the channels available for Primary school students to alert teachers or the authorities should they or any of their family members are in an abusive or violent relationship.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Students are also equipped with skills to seek help.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: This includes listing the trusted adults whom they can turn to for help.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: They are also encouraged to look out for their peers and seek help for those who display any signs of distress.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: There are also system-wide efforts to support children who are victims of abuse and domestic violence.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Teachers also monitor the well-being of the students and look out for students who are at risk of such abuses.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: In turn, the School Counsellors train the teachers in their school to pick up signs of child abuse using the Sector Specific Screening Guide (Education).

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: I understand that there is a guideline and a framework for the reporting and identifying of child abuse cases amongst Primary school students.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: What I am concerned with would be the voiceless amongst the vulnerables.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: That is, the Primary school students who will not be able to voice out in terms of abuse or any trauma that they are facing.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: For instance, perhaps, we can equip students with some form of indirect messaging to signal that they are facing such problems.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: For instance, in Poland and in certain countries, they have "Signalling for Help" – you put your thumb between these two fingers and show it as a sign that there is some form of violence happening in the home.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: This can be happening during a Zoom call or session.

speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: These are the kinds of things that perhaps Primary school students can be more aware of, that they should not be rendered voiceless and helpless.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Indeed, we are always concerned about young children.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: This takes place during the Form Teacher Guidance Period.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: They help students recognise that they can seek help from trusted adults when they are hurt or perhaps in a variety of ways.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: For instance, if someone has caused them physical pain, if someone has touched them in a way that made them feel confused, uncomfortable, sad, or if someone has touched them in their private areas without good reasons, or if someone has forced him or her to touch the adult, or someone has told them not to tell anyone that he or she had been touched.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But we recognise that young children may or may not have the verbal skills to be able to communicate effectively.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But we can all imagine that different children express themselves differently.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: What is most important is that our teachers are sensitised and have trusting relationships with the children.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: The children know that they can go to the teachers if they feel uncomfortable, if they had been hurt in any way.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: There are potentially different ways and methods that teachers can develop, for the children to be able to reflect and communicate their emotions.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I would not rule any of them out.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: And I thank the Member for his suggestions.
